scenicChapters.title: Passo Rolle and Valles Loop
scenicChapters.narrative: For 19 km this is Passo Rolle and Valles Loop, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Passo Rolle and Valles Loop
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2032 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance. Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

passo-rolle-and-valles-loop.story: 58 km one way from Siror - plan on about 59 min of riding. On the way it passes Falcade, Passo Valles and Passo Rolle. The highest point is about 2,050 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
